description.en: Accessible and customizable UI components engineered for polished React apps.
description.zh: 专为打磨高品质 React 应用而设计的无障碍优先与高度可定制组件库。

content.en: Ruru UI is a modern, accessible component library crafted for developers building polished web applications. Styled with Tailwind CSS, Ruru UI focuses on clear visual hierarchy, keyboard navigation ergonomics, and dark mode elegance.
content.zh: Ruru UI 是一套专注于提升现代 Web 应用程序细腻质感的 React 现代组件库。全面基于 Tailwind CSS 构建，强调明确的视觉层级划分、严谨舒适的键盘导航以及优雅深邃的暗色主题呈现，为开发团队提供可靠的基础控件支撑。
